## Green chile vinaigrette

For pulled pork (well, smoked at least, but why wouldn’t you smoke it?), I don’t think anything beats the vinegar style sauce from North Carolina. There are a lot of small variations (some would complain about the ketchup in this recipe).


**Source:** I think I got this from [MeatWave](https://meatwave.com/recipes/barbecue-sauce-recipe-north-carolina-vinegar-sauce).


**Ingredients:**


```{r}
#| label: green-chile-vinaigrette

dat <- tibble(
  Ingredients = c(
    "1 1/4 cup olive oil",
    "1/2 cup apple cider vinegar",
    "1/4 cup red wine vinegar",
    "3 tsp green chile powder",
    "1 1/2 - 2 tsp honey",
    "1/2 tsp salt",
    "1/2 tsp oregano"
  ),
  spcr1 = " ",
  More = c(
    "1/2 tsp black pepper (optional)",
    "1/2 tsp garlic powder (optional)",
    "",
    "",
    "Tools",
    "Blender",
    "Dressing container"
  )
)


colnames(dat)[str_detect(colnames(dat), "spcr")] <- ""
colnames(dat)[3] <- "Additional Ingredients"

dat |> 
  tt(  theme = "striped" ) |> 
  style_tt(fontsize = 0.8) |> 
  style_tt( i=0, background=bgcol, color="white") |> 
  style_tt( i=5, j=3, background=bgcol, color="white", bold=TRUE )
  # style_tt( i=0, line = "t", line_color="black", line_width = tlwd) |> 
  # style_tt( i=1, line = "t", line_color="black", line_width = tlwd) |> 
  # style_tt( i=8, line = "b", line_color="black", line_width = tlwd) |> 
  # style_tt( i=4, j=2, line = "t", line_color="black", line_width = tlwd )  |> 
  # style_tt( i=4, j=2, line = "b", line_color="black", line_width = tlwd )  |> 


```



**Directions:**

1. Measure the oil and vinegar into the blender.
2. Add the dry spices and the honey.
3. Blend it up to immerse. I tend to use several short pulses, rather than one cycle. It probably doesn’t matter.
4. Pour it into your dressing container, and it’s ready to use.

**Variations:**

- I think that the black pepper and garlic are good additions, but shouldn’t overpower the green chile powder.
- Many similar recipes include some lime juice.


**Notes:**

- I don’t keep this dressing in the fridge.
- I use this [OXO container](https://www.oxo.com/salad-dressing-shaker.html?color=Black), or at least something very much like it.
